question: List each track's name along with its album title, genre name, and media type name for tracks in the Rock genre. Order by track name and return the first 10.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name AS TrackName, al.Title AS AlbumTitle, g.Name AS GenreName, m.Name AS MediaTypeName FROM tracks t JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN genres g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN media_types m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' ORDER BY t.Name LIMIT 10

question: What is the zip code of the customer who has spent the most money in total?
gold_sql: SELECT c.PostalCode FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the phone numbers of employees who directly report to the person with the title 'General Manager'.
gold_sql: SELECT e.Phone FROM employees e JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE mgr.Title = 'General Manager'

question: For customers with more than one invoice, how many days elapsed between their first and last invoice? Return the customer id and the day difference.
gold_sql: SELECT CustomerId, CAST(julianday(MAX(InvoiceDate)) - julianday(MIN(InvoiceDate)) AS INTEGER) AS DaysBetween FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Which invoice month, combined across all years, generated the highest total revenue? Return the two-digit month and the total revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(Total) AS Revenue FROM invoices GROUP BY strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artists have an average track price higher than the overall average track price across the entire store? Return the artist name.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM artists ar JOIN albums al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN tracks t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING AVG(t.UnitPrice) > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM tracks)

question: Which playlists contain at least one track by the artist with the most albums? Return the distinct playlist names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Name FROM playlists p JOIN playlist_track pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE al.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM albums GROUP BY ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

question: List the distinct billing zip codes used on invoices for customers located in Germany.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.BillingPostalCode FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'
